name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Sun Sauna offers a special patented mixture of infrared and Full-Spectrum light waves in every infrared sauna unit they manufacture – the 100% exclusive Full-Spectrum saunas in the whole world. Each Sun Sauna is backed up by an Industry Leading Warranty that is ensured by the 1% failure rate of the components used in the sauna.



This technology, yet bringing many various health benefits to sauna users and very reliable, can be very hard to repair if there is a sudden breakage. But there is no reason to fall prey to sadness or nerves – Sun Sauna Parts are here to help! We are always ready to aid you and bring any Sun Infrared Sauna unit back online very fast, very careful and attentive, and with the finest top quality spare parts made especially for Sun Infrared Saunas.



Our clients receive the very best of everything – starting from the point when you call us with your problem and following further to a swift and top quality resolution of it for your sole benefit and happiness. Hesitate no longer and call us. We will find what is wrong with your Sun Infrared Sauna unit and help you enjoy it again in no time!
